parent_objective: design source-history materialization from the M1330 merged source export
blocked_by: M1331 admits source-history materialization design but materialized artifacts do not yet exist
supersedes: materializing the old M1273 or M1322 source corpus

public_gates: M1332 must not use private holdout
M1332 must preserve actor input contract
M1332 must preserve source identity metadata
M1332 must not materialize histories before implementation manifest
M1332 must keep global friction and halfshaft blockers explicit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not fabricate global friction coverage
do not run materialization before design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs materialization after the merged corpus expansion plan becomes admissible
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design hides global friction or halfshaft gaps
stop if design routes directly to policy objective or PPO
fallback_plan: if materialization design is feasible, implement one no-policy materialization run
if schema incompatibility appears, repair materialization input adapter first
if global friction is required before materialization, synthesize branch and open separate source branch

allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1332 designs materialization and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design command-response history materialization for later source-history objective evaluation
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization design exposes schema gaps, record them before any policy training.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1330/M1331 merged source corpus can be materialized into command-response histories while preserving source identity metadata.
success_criteria: design specifies M1330 and M1331 input artifacts
design preserves source_run_id, source_row_id, and original_pair_id
design routes to one no-policy materialization implementation
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, materialization run, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design hides global friction or halfshaft blockers
design routes directly to policy objective or PPO
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, materialization run, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1332 passes if it designs source-history materialization for the merged corpus without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, materialization run, hidden blockers, or actor-input expansion.
